cards.front: Estabas muy elegante anoche. ¿A qué ibas, a una cita?
cards.back: You were all dressed up last night. Off on a date, were you?

cards.front: Samantha estaba muy elegante el sábado pasado. ¿A qué iba, a una fiesta?
cards.back: Samantha was all dressed up last Saturday. Off to a party, was she?

cards.front: Bueno, bueno, bueno. ¡Vas muy elegante! ¿A qué vas, a una fiesta?
cards.back: Well, well, well. You're all dressed up! Off to a party, are you?

cards.front: ¡Elizabeth tenía una cita interesante anoche e iba imponente!
cards.back: Elizabeth was on a hot date last night and she was dressed to kill!

cards.front: Ella tiene una reunión importante mañana. Irá imponente, como de costumbre.
cards.back: She has a big meeting tomorrow. She'll be dressed to kill as usual.

cards.front: Carmen se va a una cena y va imponente.
cards.back: Carmen's off to a dinner party and she's dressed to kill.

cards.front: No puedes salir así. ¡Qué emperifollado vas!
cards.back: You can't go out like that. You look like a dog's dinner!

cards.front: ¿A dónde va vestida así? ¡Qué emperifollada va!
cards.back: Where's she going dressed like that? She looks like a dog's dinner!

cards.front: No me digas que Gary se va al baile vestido así. ¡Qué pintas lleva! ¡Qué emperifollado!
cards.back: Don't tell me Gary's off to the ball dressed like that. The state of him! He looks like a dog's dinner!

cards.front: ¿Soy demasiado mayor para este vestido? Siento que voy disfrazada de jovencita.
cards.back: Am I too old for this gown? I feel like mutton dressed as lamb.

cards.front: Ese conjunto no le va a alguien de su edad. Parece que va disfrazada de jovencita.
cards.back: That outfit isn't suitable for someone of her age. She looks like mutton dressed as lamb.

cards.front: Ojalá no me hubiera puesto este conjunto. Siento que voy disfrazada de jovencita.
cards.back: I wish I hadn't worn this outfit. I feel like mutton dressed as lamb.

cards.front: ¡No te lo vas a creer, pero Harry se presentó como Dios le trajo al mundo!
cards.back: You won't believe me, but Harry turned up in his birthday suit!

cards.front: Un hombre de su edad no debería ir por ahí como Dios le trajo al mundo.
cards.back: A man of his age shouldn't go around in his birthday suit.

cards.front: ¡No me digas que se presentó tal y como Dios le trajo al mundo! ¡Qué pintas!
cards.back: Don't tell me he turned up in his birthday suit! The state of him!

cards.front: Vaya, esa alfombra está muy desgastada.
cards.back: Wow, there's a lot of wear on that rug.

cards.front: Esas ruedas están considerablemente desgastadas.
cards.back: There's a serious amount of wear on those tires.

cards.front: El manillar está muy desgastado, pero está bien.
cards.back: There's a lot of wear on the handlebars but they're OK.

cards.front: Tuvimos que tirar la bici debido al desgaste.
cards.back: We had to throw out the bike due to wear and tear.

cards.front: Tuvieron que tirar la alfombra debido al desgaste.
cards.back: They had to throw the rug out due to wear and tear.

cards.front: Tendrás que pagar cualquier daño que causes en el piso aparte del desgaste por su uso normal.
cards.back: You'll have to pay for any damage to the apartment that isn't wear and tear.

cards.front: No tires esa chaqueta. Le queda mucho uso.
cards.back: Don't throw out that jacket. There's plenty of wear left in it.

cards.front: ¿Por qué lo tiraste? Le quedaba mucho uso.
cards.back: Why did you throw it out? There was still plenty of wear left in it.

cards.front: Todavía le queda mucho uso a esos tacones. No los tires.
cards.back: There's still plenty of wear left in those heels. Don't chuck them yet.

cards.front: Creo que no deberías salir así. Pareces un poco agotado.
cards.back: I don't think you should go out like that. You look a bit worse for wear.

cards.front: No me digas que compraste esa tienda que hay en la esquina. Está un poco deteriorada, ¿no?
cards.back: Don't tell me you bought that shop on the corner. It's a bit worse for wear, isn't it?

cards.front: Carol está un poco agotada después de la inauguración de la casa anoche. ¡Mira cómo está!
cards.back: Carol's a bit worse for wear after the housewarming last night. The state of her!

cards.front: Mi bicicleta se cayó en el río, pero la sacamos y no tuvo ningún daño.
cards.back: My bike fell into the river but we got it out and it was none the worse for wear.

cards.front: Tuvimos una cita, pero no funcionó y nuestra amistad no se vio afectada.
cards.back: We went on a date but it didn't work out and our friendship is none the worse for wear.

cards.front: Me caí por las escaleras, pero no me hice ningún daño.
cards.back: I fell down the stairs but I'm none the worse for wear.

cards.front: Una vez que se pasen los efectos de los analgésicos, puede que empieces a sentir un poco de dolor.
cards.back: Once the painkillers wear off, you might feel a little pain.

cards.front: Una vez que se pasó el efecto de los analgésicos, los dientes le empezaron a doler.
cards.back: Once the painkillers wore off, her teeth started to hurt.

cards.front: Si no hubieras esperado a tomar otra dosis, puede que no se te hubiera pasado el efecto de los analgésicos ahora.
cards.back: If you hadn't waited to take another dose, maybe the painkillers wouldn't be wearing off now.

cards.front: No te preocupes. El mareo se te pasará con el tiempo.
cards.back: Don't worry. The dizziness will eventually wear off.

cards.front: Me voy a acostar hasta que el mareo se me pase. Cuando ocurra, estaré perfectamente.
cards.back: I'm going to lie down till the dizziness wears off. When it does, I'll be fine.

cards.front: El mareo es completamente normal después de un susto como ése. Se te pasará una vez que hayas comido algo.
cards.back: Dizziness is completely normal after a scare like that. It'll wear off once you've had something to eat.

cards.front: No sentirán dolor hasta que no se les hayan pasado los efectos del choque inicial.
cards.back: They won't grieve until the initial shock wears off.

cards.front: Cuando se les pasen los efectos del choque inicial, empezarán a hacer el duelo.
cards.back: When the initial shock wears off, they'll start to mourn.

cards.front: El duelo no empezará hasta que los efectos del choque inicial se les hayan pasado.
cards.back: The mourning won't start until the initial shock wears off.

cards.front: Los efectos de la adrenalina no se les pasaron durante un rato, incluso después de habérseles pasado el choque inicial.
cards.back: The adrenaline didn't wear off for a while, even after the initial shock had worn off.

cards.front: Una vez que se me pasaron los efectos de la adrenalina, empecé a sentir el dolor.
cards.back: Once the adrenaline had worn off, I started to feel the pain.

cards.front: Cuando se te pasen los efectos de la adrenalina, las heridas te van a doler y vas a necesitar unos analgésicos.
cards.back: When the adrenaline wears off, your injuries are going to hurt and you're going to be in need of some painkillers.

cards.front: Ella está bastante colada por él, pero creo que la novedad se le acabará pasando.
cards.back: She's quite infatuated with him but I reckon the novelty will wear off.

cards.front: Ella está bastante colada por la bici de montaña estos días. Probablemente se le pase la novedad.
cards.back: She's quite crazy about mountain biking these days. The novelty will probably wear off.

cards.front: Ella está bastante colada por su trabajo nuevo, pero yo diría que la novedad se le pasará pronto.
cards.back: She's quite taken with her new job but I'd say the novelty will wear off.

cards.front: Lo sabríamos si estuviera disgustado; él no oculta sus sentimientos.
cards.back: We'd know if he were upset, he wears his heart on his sleeve.

cards.front: No lo sabríamos si estuviera deprimido; no es fácil saber cómo se siente.
cards.back: We wouldn't know if he were down; he doesn't exactly wear his heart on his sleeve.

cards.front: No es de los que ocultan sus sentimientos. Es fácil saber lo que siente.
cards.back: He's not the type to hide his emotions. He wears his heart on his sleeve.

cards.front: Me dejé el pellejo cepillando el suelo.
cards.back: I wore my fingers to the bone scrubbing that floor.

cards.front: Casi me dejo el pellejo quitando esa mancha.
cards.back: I almost wore my fingers to the bone to get rid of that stain.

cards.front: Mi madre se dejó el pellejo trabajando en ese restaurante.
cards.back: My mother wore her fingers to the bone working in that restaurant.

cards.front: Mi madre llevaba los pantalones en nuestra casa.
cards.back: My mother wore the pants in our house.

cards.front: Yo llevo los pantalones en este matrimonio, que no se te olvide.
cards.back: I wear the trousers in this marriage, and don't you forget it.

cards.front: Él lleva los pantalones en esta relación y no deja que se me olvide.
cards.back: He wears the trousers in this relationship and he doesn't let me forget it.

cards.front: Dormí en su sofá hasta que ya no era bienvenido.
cards.back: I crashed on their couch until I wore out my welcome.

cards.front: No se puede dormir en el sofá de alguien durante tanto tiempo, al final no serás bienvenido.
cards.back: You can't crash on someone's couch for so long, eventually you'll wear out your welcome.

cards.front: Siento que ya no soy bienvenido. Creo que más vale que me vaya.
cards.back: I feel like I'm wearing out my welcome. I think I better go.

cards.front: Él lleva dos semanas durmiendo en mi sofá ya. Se me agota la paciencia.
cards.back: He's been crashing on my couch for two weeks now. My patience is wearing thin.

cards.front: He sido paciente hasta este momento, pero ahora se me acaba la paciencia.
cards.back: I've been patient until now but my patience is wearing thin.

cards.front: No me ha molestado hasta este momento, pero se me acaba la paciencia.
cards.back: I haven't minded until now but my patience is wearing thin.

cards.front: No te preocupes por el código de vestir. Puedes vestirte de manera más informal para la fiesta de la empresa.
cards.back: Don't worry about the dress code. You can dress down for the staff party.

cards.front: No hay código de vestir los viernes. Podemos vestirnos más informales.
cards.back: There's no dress code on Fridays. We can dress down.

cards.front: Creo que puedes vestirte de manera más informal. No es un acontecimiento con caché.
cards.back: I think you can dress down. It's not a very fancy affair.

cards.front: Mi jefe me echó la bronca porque llegué tarde.
cards.back: My boss dressed me down because I turned up late.

cards.front: Me echaron la bronca por tener mala actitud en el trabajo.
cards.back: I was dressed down for having a bad attitude at work.

cards.front: Mi jefe me echó una buena bronca porque no respeté el código de vestir.
cards.back: My boss gave me a good dressing down because I didn't observe the dress code.

cards.front: Él seguía insistiendo e insistiendo hasta que me ganó por cansancio y yo dije que sí.
cards.back: He kept asking and asking until he wore me down and I said yes.

cards.front: Rogaron y rogaron hasta que le ganaron por cansancio y consintió.
cards.back: They begged and begged until they wore him down and he agreed.

cards.front: Yo supliqué y supliqué y al final les gané por cansancio y lo aceptaron.
cards.back: I pleaded and pleaded and in the end I wore them down and they accepted.

cards.front: La marea desgastó las rocas de la costa.
cards.back: The tide wore away the rocks on the coast.

cards.front: Había un mural en aquella pared, pero a medida que pasaba el tiempo, se desgastó.
cards.back: There was a mural on that wall but over time, it wore away.

cards.front: A medida que pase el tiempo, el brillo de esta puerta se desgastará.
cards.back: Over time, the polish on this door will wear away.

cards.front: El sonido de este violín me está crispando los nervios.
cards.back: The sound of this violin is wearing on my last nerve.

cards.front: Su súplica constante de él me está crispando los nervios.
cards.back: His constant pleading is wearing on my nerves.

cards.front: No paran de rogar. Me están empezando a crispar los nervios.
cards.back: They keep begging. It's starting to wear on my last nerve.

cards.front: Ella terminó haciendo striptease en un bar de alterne en el centro de la ciudad.
cards.back: She ended up stripping in a seedy bar in the city centre.

cards.front: Ella terminó trabajando como bailarina exótica en un local de striptease.
cards.back: She ended up working as a stripper at a strip club.

cards.front: Espero que ella no termine haciendo striptease para ganarse la vida.
cards.back: I hope she doesn't end up stripping for a living.

cards.front: Él se quitó la ropa y se tiró al lago.
cards.back: He stripped off his clothes and threw himself in the lake.

cards.front: Estaba congelado, así que me quité la ropa y me metí en la ducha.
cards.back: I was freezing so I stripped off and jumped in the shower.

cards.front: La mayoría de los trabajadores se habían quitado la ropa hasta los pantalones para combatir el calor intenso del mediodía.
cards.back: Most of the workmen had stripped off to the waist to combat the intense midday heat.

cards.front: Me puse las zapatillas de deporte y bajé corriendo para atender la puerta.
cards.back: I slipped on my trainers and ran downstairs to answer the door.

cards.front: Él se puso unas zapatillas de andar por casa y corrió a la puerta.
cards.back: He slipped on a pair of slippers and ran to the door.

cards.front: Ella se quitó las zapatillas de deporte y se tiró al lago.
cards.back: She slipped off her trainers and threw herself in the lake.

cards.front: Dame un minuto mientras me pongo algo más cómodo.
cards.back: Just give me a minute while I slip into something more comfortable.

cards.front: Ella se puso algo más cómodo y se sirvió una copa de vino.
cards.back: She slipped into something more comfortable and poured herself a glass of wine.

cards.front: Por favor, ponte una copa mientras me pongo algo un poco más cómodo.
cards.back: Please, pour yourself a drink while I slip into something a little more comfortable.

cards.front: Me pasé del todo arreglándome para la entrevista. Me sentí como un verdadero idiota.
cards.back: I was totally overdressed for the interview. I felt like a right idiot.

cards.front: Ella se pasó totalmente arreglándose para su primer día. Parecía una idiota integral.
cards.back: She turned up totally overdressed for her first day. She looked like a right fool.

cards.front: No vine lo suficientemente arreglado y mi jefe me echó la bronca.
cards.back: I turned up a bit underdressed and my boss gave me a right dressing down.
